items.title: Jamal Adams: Done for season
items.description:
Adams suffered a season-ending right knee injury in the Vikings' 13-10 preseason win over the Giants on Saturday, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Kyle Monangai: Believed to be "fine" after exiting practice
items.description:
Monangai is believed to be "fine" after exiting Sunday's practice with a right-knee injury, and he will undergo an MRI, Adam Schefter of ESPN reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Carson Beck: Day-to-day with rib injury
items.description:
Cardinals head coach Mike LaFleur said Sunday that Beck is day-to-day with his rib injury, Josh Weinfuss of ESPN.com reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Kyle Monangai: Exits practice with apparent injury
items.description:
Monangai left Sunday's practice due to an apparent right-knee injury, Brad Biggs of the Chicago Tribune reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: George Kittle: Confident he'll avoid PUP for Week 1
items.description:
Kittle (Achilles) said Sunday that he's "very confident" he won't start the season on PUP and that he's still got a chance to play Week 1 versus the Rams, Nick Wagoner of ESPN.com reports.
